items.title: XTI AEROSPACE INVESTOR ALERT: Bragar Eagel & Squire, P.C. Announces that a Class Action Lawsuit Has Been Filed Against XTI Aerospace, Inc. and Encourages Investors to Contact the Firm
items.summary: A class action lawsuit has been filed against XTI Aerospace, Inc. in the U.S. District Court for the Southern District of New York. The lawsuit alleges that senior executives engaged in undisclosed activities and made materially false and misleading statements about the company's business operations and prospects during the period of April 15, 2026 to August 17, 2026. Investors who purchased XTI securities during this period and suffered losses are encouraged to contact the law firm.

items.title: Portnoy Law Firm Announces Class Action on Behalf of XTI Aerospace, Inc. Investors
items.summary: The Portnoy Law Firm has announced a class action lawsuit on behalf of XTI Aerospace investors who purchased securities between April 15, 2026 and August 17, 2026. The lawsuit alleges that senior executives engaged in undisclosed activities requiring Board review, raising doubts about the effectiveness of disclosure controls and procedures, which prevented timely filing of earnings reports. Investors have until October 27, 2026 to file a lead plaintiff motion.

items.title: INVESTOR ALERT: Pomerantz Law Firm Reminds Investors with Losses on their Investment in XTI Aerospace, Inc. of Class Action Lawsuit and Upcoming Deadlines – XTIA
items.summary: Pomerantz Law Firm has filed class action lawsuits against XTI Aerospace, Inc. and other companies for alleged securities fraud and unlawful business practices. XTI's stock fell 15.92% after the company filed a late notice with the SEC on August 17, 2026, citing an internal review of its former CEO who resigned that day. Investors have until October 27, 2026, to join the class action.

items.title: Bronstein, Gewirtz & Grossman LLC Urges XTI Aerospace, Inc. Investors to Act: Class Action Filed Alleging Investor Harm
items.summary: A class action lawsuit has been filed against XTI Aerospace, Inc. (NASDAQ: XTIA) alleging that company executives made materially false statements and failed to disclose material adverse facts about the business. The lawsuit covers investors who purchased securities between April 15, 2026 and August 17, 2026. The lead plaintiff deadline is October 27, 2026.

items.title: XTIA INVESTOR ALERT; Class Action Lawsuit Filed on Behalf of XTI Aerospace, Inc. Investors – Holzer & Holzer, LLC Encourages Investors With Losses to Contact the Firm
items.summary: Shareholder class action lawsuits have been filed against XTI Aerospace, Hyliion Holdings, and Innventure, alleging that executives engaged in undisclosed activities and made false statements about business operations. The lawsuits claim disclosure controls were ineffective and earnings reports would be delayed. Investors who purchased shares during specified periods and experienced losses are encouraged to contact the law firm.

items.title: Securities Fraud Investigation Into XTI Aerospace, Inc. (XTIA) Continues – Shareholders Who Lost Money Urged To Contact Glancy Prongay Wolke & Rotter LLP, a Leading Securities Fraud Law Firm
items.summary: XTI Aerospace announced on August 17, 2026, that it could not timely file its Form 10-Q due to an internal review of its former CEO who resigned, along with other corporate governance matters. The stock fell 15.9% to $1.32 on August 18, 2026, prompting a securities fraud investigation by Glancy Prongay Wolke & Rotter LLP on behalf of affected investors.
